ordering_policy.row_order: Sort train and query rows by SHA256(UTF8(pid)), with pid as deterministic collision tiebreaker, before selection and prediction. Identity/order keys never become predictors.
ordering_policy.input_equivalence: All selected predictor values must be numerically identical. NaNs compare equal; positive/negative zero compare equal. Distinct vectors are never quantized or merged.
ordering_policy.prediction_ties: Within each query group of exactly identical full predictor vectors, assign every row the arithmetic mean of its raw predictions using math.fsum over sorted float64 values.
ordering_policy.raw_preservation: Save raw and canonical prediction for every pid, exact duplicate groups and policy hash. All scoring uses canonical predictions with Spearman average ranks.
ordering_policy.registration_basis: R8order numerical audit found8 all-missing duplicate inputs with floating-point score splitting; no outcome score was used to choose this policy.
ordering_policy.new_baseline: Every background baseline reruns under this policy. Do not pool these scores with raw-prediction R8s or earlier studies.

study: R9g XGBoost GPU family and fixed saved-prediction blends
training_target: Original frozen B yy, unchanged; no target transforms or feature reselection
native_missingness: Native NaNs; no imputation or query-derived preprocessing.
evaluation_rule: Fit1200 trees once without eval_set or early stopping; fixed iteration_range (0,200)/(0,600)/(0,1200) predictions, no score-based stopping.
reference_gate: Three original B TabICL32 raw/canonical/score/full-audit reference replays gate interpretation.

blend_diagnostic.method: Within-cohort average-tied rank/n percentiles, exact doubled-integer rank sums; same-seed and fixed equal-three-seed mean endpoints separately. All checkpoints/weights/anchors saved, no favorable-seed selection.

GPU_nondeterminism: Actual XGBoost GPU seeds/configuration and outputs preserved; no bit-exact XGBoost requirement; exact three B TabICL gates unchanged.
training_order: Every experimental model: draft cohort ascending, then SHA256(str(pid)) ascending. Original query canonical order unchanged. Training qid metadata is cohort group only and never a predictor.
sequential_start: Start only after frozen R9f completion without errors, all3 baseline exact reference gates, and registered saved blends complete. No F scores used in G design.
